Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing health carriers to offer plans equivalent to the basic health plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing health carriers to offer plansequivalent to the basic health plan; adding a new section to chapter48.43 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Health carriers may offer a health benefit plan that is actuariallyequivalent to the same schedule of covered basic health care servicesestablished by the administrator of the health care authority fornonsubsidized enrollees. The health benefit plan may include physicianservices, inpatient and outpatient hospital services, prescriptiondrugs and medications, and other services that may be necessary forbasic health care. Health carriers must be subject to the sameprovisions of Title 48 RCW as required of the Washington basic healthcare plan under RCW 70.47.130.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 SB 6824state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
